item: Ingest door: furniture strip + menu/paywall stub signals
summary: Ad-placeholder and app-banner paragraphs are stripped before judging and hashing; a thin body that is site-menu lines or a Nordic/Finnish subscriber prompt is classified menu_stub/paywall_stub (mark via the existing quarantine stamp, never delete). The quarantine job (dry-run by default; import-time screening stamps new imports) reads thin bodies for the same signals. Built from four real stored pages.
